name: Minnesota Zoo
tagline: Apple Valley sprawling zoo — monorail vibes historically, big outdoor loops.

practical.transit_note: South of Minneapolis; car for most visitors.
practical.best_start: Tropics trail or Northern Trail icons first.

do_not_list.name: Reticulated giraffe
do_not_list.reason: Minnesota Zoo does not keep giraffes.

do_not_list.name: African elephant
do_not_list.reason: Minnesota Zoo does not keep elephants.

do_not_list.name: African lion
do_not_list.reason: Not on MN Zoo collection (visitor guides explicitly note no lions).

do_not_list.name: Nile hippo
do_not_list.reason: Not confirmed / not a MN Zoo icon.

do_not_list.name: Western lowland gorilla
do_not_list.reason: Not a MN Zoo public icon on current trails.

do_not_list.name: Sumatran tiger
do_not_list.reason: Official animals list: Amur tiger on Northern Trail — not Sumatran.

challenges.text: Penguins: take 15 seconds on the African penguin — what is it doing right now?
Discovery Bay / aquatic: take 15 seconds on the Shark — what is it doing right now?
Watch one animal do something for 15 full seconds (eat, climb, pace, rest)
Match two patterns in different places (stripes, spots, shells)
Find something tiny next to something huge
Find a cool detail most visitors walk past
Stand still 20 seconds — loudest sound that isn’t people?
Find water used by animals (pool, moat, splash, drink)
Copy an animal move once (stomp, stretch, tip-toe, roar soft)

bonus_hunt.easter_egg: ★ Easter egg: find a park map or zone sign — name one animal that lives that way
bonus_hunt.easter_egg_little: ★ Easter egg: pick a favorite bench — sit 60 seconds and name three sounds
